records.what: DuckDB memory_limit 20GB (dataset doc §8: <= 12GB) for leakcheck and all sidecars; batch_rows 400000 for every collection
records.why: carried over from Tinkoff d1, where a self-join feature ran out of memory at 4GB and val/holdout needed 400k batches; set before the first S sidecar to avoid a rerun
records.effect: none on values: sidecar output is batch-invariant by contract (§3) and memory is not a parameter of the set; batch_rows is recorded in sidecars/<c>/report.json (400000 everywhere); the memory limit is a CLI argument and is recorded only here
records.timing: decided after the S prereg (b5c9240) and before leakcheck and every S sidecar, i.e. before any S number; kaggle-2020-09-17 uses the same parameters
